thread:
incident-bot: Paging: suspected GeoDNS/EDNS inconsistency impacting EU endpoints (edge-eu.redwood.ai) - multiple customers reporting 504/connection-reset to EU region. Severity: P2. @net-oncall please acknowledge.

net-oncall: acknowledged - starting triage. Can someone drop latest synth check and resolver dig outputs?

Marcus: We started seeing failures ~09:07 UTC. Synths in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 show intermittent DNS failures and then hits to a global fallback IP that doesn't present the eu cert. Quick dig from a couple public resolvers: 
```
dig @1.1.1.1 edge-eu.redwood.ai A +short
-> 52.14.23.11

dig @8.8.8.8 edge-eu.redwood.ai A +short
-> 3.120.45.66

# dig +trace shows Cloudflare authoritative answers differ by resolver and EDNS
```

Rina: Noted - we pushed a geo-steering update to Cloudflare ~40m ago to route some traffic to a newly scaled eu-west-2 pool. My suspicion: Cloudflare is using EDNS / ASN heuristics and some authoritative edges haven't converged, resulting in mixed A answers.

Asha: Route53 records exist as a secondary failover; health checks green. However, some customers with IP allowlists are hitting the wrong IP and getting TLS SNI mismatch -> 504/502. Also seeing a small number of resolver caches holding stale answers.

Marcus: Captured tcpdump from an affected client: TCP handshake completes to 3.120.45.66 but server presents global wildcard cert -> SNI mismatch, client aborts.

ops-bot: Alert: inference-api eu region 5xx increased by 350% since 09:07 UTC.

net-oncall: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Temporarily disable Cloudflare Geo Steering for edge-eu.redwood.ai so authoritative answers become single-region (force eu-west-1). 2) Disable EDNS-client-subnet (ECS) at Cloudflare to reduce resolver variance. 3) Update Route53 to weight 100->eu-west-1 as fast fallback. 4) Notify support to inform affected customers and provide IPs for allowlists. Any objections?

Rina: Agree with steps. Note: TTL is 60s currently which helps; caches should converge quickly but some resolvers will hold longer. We cannot purge external resolver caches.

Marcus: I'll run the Cloudflare change now.

Marcus: (commands)
```
# cfcli dns update --zone redwood.ai --name edge-eu --geo-steering off
# cfcli settings set ecs disabled --zone redwood.ai
# aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge-eu.redwood.ai","Type":"A","TTL":60,"SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1","Weight":100,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"52.14.23.11"}]}}]}' --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE
```
Marcus: Cloudflare geo steering set to off at 09:18 UTC. ECS disabled at 09:19 UTC. Route53 weights updated at 09:20 UTC.

support-bot: Notifying affected tickets with status: "we are mitigating a DNS routing issue, routing traffic to eu-west-1, ETA 10-20m". 

Seth: For enterprise customers with allowlists: distributing eu-west-1 IPs now and opening dedicated threads for fingerprinted clients.

Marcus: Dig after mitigation from multiple public resolvers: 
```
dig @1.1.1.1 edge-eu.redwood.ai A +short
-> 52.14.23.11

dig @8.8.8.8 edge-eu.redwood.ai A +short
-> 52.14.23.11
```

ops-bot: DNS authoritative answers collapsed to a single answer across observed edges within 4 minutes. 5xx rate returning toward baseline.

Asha: Support reports most tickets auto-resolved as customers retried; a handful required clearing local DNS caches or waiting for TTL. No data loss, availability impacted for a subset of EU latency-sensitive customers.

net-oncall: Current status: mitigated, monitoring. I'll monitor for 30m then hand off. Please collect artifacts for postmortem.

Rina: Root-cause hypothesis: race between geo-steering publish and Cloudflare edge convergence combined with EDNS-client-subnet variance caused inconsistent authoritative answers. Action items: add preflight validation for geo map changes, block direct geo pushes without canary, and add automated detection for mixed-authoritative-answers.

Marcus: I'll collate Cloudflare edge logs, audit diff of the geo map change, and the synth traces. Asha will gather customer ticket timelines. Seth will coordinate allowlist outreach.

ops-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation at 09:40 UTC - @net-oncall to @Seth.

net-oncall: Handoff summary -> mixed DNS authoritative answers after geo steering update -> TLS SNI mismatch -> 5xx spikes. Mitigation -> disabled geo steering + disabled ECS + forced Route53 eu-west-1 answer. Monitoring stable.

Seth: Acknowledged handoff. I'll watch the channel for the next window and start the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "resolved (mitigated)" at 09:25 UTC. Duration: ~18 minutes. Postmortem required.

Rina: Postmortem owners: Rina/Marcus (network/SRE) to write RCA, Asha (support) to document customer impact, Product to review geo rollout process. Schedule follow-up review tomorrow.

Marcus: Attaching initial dig outputs and tcpdump to the postmortem doc.

net-oncall: Thanks team. If anything resurfaces ping this channel; otherwise we close in 30m.
